title: Storage Terminal
description: Storage Terminal in your vanilla world! Totally clientside!
body: # Storage Terminal – Client-Side Storage Management Mod Have you ever seen **Applied Energistics** or **Refined Storage**? Those storage systems are highly functional. This mod provides a comparable lightweight alternative. ## Overview Storage Terminal adds a client-side storage interface that enables store/request operations for all nearby chests from a single GUI. **Key feature**: In the vanilla crafting table, clicking any recipe automatically requests the required ingredients from connected chests. The mod operates entirely client-side and is compatible with any vanilla or modded server without server-side installation. *** ## Setup 1. Press **Right Shift** to open the Keybind Configuration menu. 2. Assign keys for: * **AutoStash** * **Storage Manager** Alternatively, configure keys via **Options → Controls**. **Default keybinds** * AutoStash: **B** * Storage Manager: **V** *** ## Usage ### Scanning Chests 1. Press the **Storage Manager** key (**V** by default). 2. Click **BUILD**. 3. The mod will automatically scan and register all nearby chests. 4. A chat notification confirms when the scan is complete. *** ### Item Controls | Action |Result | | ------------- |------------------------------ | | Right click |Request +1 item | | Left click |Request +64 items (full stack) | | Shift + Click |Subtract equivalent quantity | While holding an item, clicking an empty slot in the terminal GUI stores it in the nearest registered chest. *** ### Crafting Integration | Action |Result | | -------------------- |------------------------------------ | | Click recipe |Request ingredients for 1 craft | | Shift + Click recipe |Request ingredients for 1 full stack | The mod automatically pulls exact quantities from connected chests and performs the craft. *** ## Technical Specifications * **Side**: Client-side only (no server installation required) * **Compatibility**: Fabric and NeoForge * **Minecraft versions**: 1.20+ / 1.21.1 / 1.21+ / 26.1+ * **Performance**: Lightweight, minimal impact on FPS or TPS **Download**: [CurseForge – Storage Terminal](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/storage-terminal) **Support**: [Discord](https://discord.gg/Zhsz3fWgWn) If you encounter any issues, please leave a comment or join the Discord server for assistance.
